# Codex

> Collection registry (Pokédex-style discovered / owned tracking).

- Package: `Codex` · Category: Economy & items
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: [Data](Data.md)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Codex")` (server) / `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Codex")` (shared/client keys)

## `GaxiaServer.Codex`

- Runs: **server only (Script / server ModuleScript)**
- Source: `src/ServerStorage/Gaxia_Packages_Server/Lib/CodexService.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local GaxiaServer = require(game:GetService("ServerStorage").Gaxia_Packages_Server)
local Codex = GaxiaServer.Codex
```

### Functions

- `Codex.Register(entryId: string, def: EntryDef?): ()`
- `Codex.RegisterMany(defs: { [string]: EntryDef }): ()`
- `Codex.DefineSet(setName: string, entryIds: { string }, reward: any?): ()`
- `Codex.IsRegistered(entryId: string): boolean`
- `Codex.GetCatalogSize(): number`
- `Codex.Discover(player: Player, entryId: string, amount: number?): DiscoverResult`
  Record that `player` collected `entryId` (+amount). Returns {isNew, count}.
- `Codex.Has(player: Player, entryId: string): boolean`
- `Codex.GetCount(player: Player, entryId: string): number`

- `Codex.GetCompletion(player: Player): number`
  Fraction of the catalog discovered (0..1).
- `Codex.IsSetComplete(player: Player, setName: string): boolean`

### Signals

Connect with `:Connect(function(...) end)`; the parameters are the payload types, in order.

- `Codex.OnDiscover` — `Signal<Player, string, boolean>`
  (player, entryId, isNew) on every Discover
- `Codex.OnSetComplete` — `Signal<Player, string, any>`
  (player, setName, reward) once per set, the first time all its entries are collected
